js: (() => {window.__rk=(asset)=>{const C=window.CITY,r=C.RINKS.records.find(q=>q.assetId===asset),site=C.rinkStats.sites.find(q=>q.assetId===asset);if(!r||!site)throw new Error('Rink not drawn '+asset);const rect=C.outlineRectangle(r.polygons[0].outer);let p=[rect.x,rect.z];if(!C.inRecord(r,...p)){const xs=r.polygons[0].outer.map(q=>q[0]),zs=r.polygons[0].outer.map(q=>q[1]);outer:for(let x=Math.min(...xs);x<Math.max(...xs);x+=1)for(let z=Math.min(...zs);z<Math.max(...zs);z+=1)if(C.inRecord(r,x,z)){p=[x,z];break outer;}}return {r,site,rect,p,px:-rect.az,pz:rect.ax};};window.__rkView=(asset,{side=1,along=.45,dist=1,height=1,fov=55}={})=>{const {site,rect,px,pz}=window.__rk(asset),d=(rect.width/2+rect.length*.35+14)*dist,x=rect.x+px*d*side+rect.ax*rect.length*along,z=rect.z+pz*d*side+rect.az*rect.length*along;window.__CITY_APP.cameraSystem.cinema=()=>({pos:[x,site.y+18*height+rect.length*.25*height,z],look:[rect.x,site.y,rect.z],fov});};const C=window.CITY,a=window.__CITY_APP,s=C.rinkStats,t=C.tennisStats,p=C.parkedStats;const rinkRej=s.rejected&&s.rejected.map?s.rejected.map(x=>x.assetId?x.assetId+':'+x.reason:JSON.stringify(x)):s.rejected;console.log('[ride-check] eglinton-rinks-courts-cars '+JSON.stringify({search:location.search,season:s.season,sceneDate:s.sceneDate,rinks:{source:s.sourceCount,placed:s.placed,rejected:rinkRej,triangles:[s.surfaceTriangles,s.boardTriangles],colliders:s.colliders,boards:s.boards,surfaces:s.sites.map(x=>x.assetId+':'+x.surface)},tennis:{source:t.sourceCount,placed:t.placed,rejected:t.rejected,pads:t.pads&&t.pads.length,rejectedPads:t.rejectedPads},parked:{tier:p.tier,cap:p.cap,source:p.source,kept:p.kept,laneDropped:p.laneDropped,patioDropped:p.patioDropped,valleyDropped:p.valleyDropped,colliders:p.colliders,ms:p.ms,decodeMs:p.decodeMs,near:p.near,far:p.far},heapMB:performance.memory?Math.round(performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize/1048576):null,readyAt:window.__mapScaleReadyAt}));})()
